description: Ministry of Labour - The Industrial Dispute between Heineken Lanka Ltd., Vs. Inter Company Employees Union No. 10, Council Lane, Dehiwela (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a company and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions including wage structures, allowances, working conditions, and incentive schemes. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves the official publication of a legally binding agreement and regulatory framework governing employment terms, consistent with the definition of "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements."
